findings.evidence: `GraphTwisted.lean:187-188` `| ⟨⟨.E8 _, hv⟩, _⟩ | ⟨⟨.F4 _, hv⟩, _⟩ | ⟨⟨.G2 _, hv⟩, _⟩ => ValidLieTypeIndex.geckFrobenius ⟨_, hv⟩` versus `l.207-208` `UnimodularExceptionalIndex.steinberg ⟨⟨⟨_, hv⟩, by simp⟩, h⟩`; `Unimodular.lean:172-173` `def steinberg : d.AmbientGroup →* d.AmbientGroup := d.1.1.geckFrobenius` and `l.178-180` "deliberately not a `simp` lemma: `steinberg_geckRootSubgroup` and `coe_steinberg_apply` are the normal forms ... unfolding to `TauCeti.ValidLieTypeIndex.geckFrobenius` would keep them from firing".
findings.fix: Bind `h` and define the branch as `UnimodularExceptionalIndex.steinberg ⟨⟨⟨_, hv⟩, by simp⟩, h⟩`, exactly as `steinberg` does at l.207-208 (still `rfl`, since `steinberg` is by definition `geckFrobenius`); restate `frobenius_E8`/`frobenius_F4`/`frobenius_G2` against it; and close the three proof branches at l.493-498 with `UnimodularExceptionalIndex.steinberg_geckRootSubgroup ⟨⟨⟨_, hv⟩, by simp⟩, h⟩ (.inl i) u`, as `steinberg_simpleRootSubgroup` already does at l.537-541.
findings.issue: The `E8`/`F4`/`G2` branch of `frobenius` is `ValidLieTypeIndex.geckFrobenius ⟨_, hv⟩`, not the family map `UnimodularExceptionalIndex.steinberg`, which `AmbientGroup` (l.127), `simpleRootSubgroup` (l.166) and `steinberg` (l.207) all use for the same three constructors. `Unimodular.lean:175-182` states that `steinberg_eq_geckFrobenius` is deliberately not `simp` because `steinberg_geckRootSubgroup`/`coe_steinberg_apply`/`mem_fixedSubgroup_steinberg_iff` are the normal forms of that family, so a consumer landed in `geckFrobenius` shape by `frobenius_E8`/`frobenius_F4`/`frobenius_G2` (l.383-386, 402-405, 421-424) must unfold the seal backwards to reach them. The docstrings of those three lemmas already assert the map "is the Steinberg endomorphism of the family" without ever stating that equation, and the `frobenius` docstring (l.175-176) claims the family API names no Frobenius on the untwisted branches — for these three it names `UnimodularExceptionalIndex.steinberg`.

summary: Proof style matches the model assembly (branch `rfl` equations, per-constructor `rw` + `exact`, documented defeq on the group instances), and the 13-fold repetition is forced by the type dependency. The one fixable issue: the new `frobenius` on the `E8`/`F4`/`G2` branches bypasses `UnimodularExceptionalIndex.steinberg` for the lower-level `ValidLieTypeIndex.geckFrobenius`, which the Unimodular file deliberately keeps sealed.
